disclosures: Edition 01 scores are a first desk review of each venue's stated pairing structure. Market figures, contract addresses and venue links are still being verified, so they show as not published.
o1.exchange is on the watchlist. It is not admitted until a verified contract is on record.
No venue paid for inclusion, placement or removal. There are no affiliate links in this edition.

venues.name: Long.xyz
venues.thesis: Lists Robinhood stock tokens as the quote asset, so the claim to a real share is the strongest in the register.

rationale.asset: Pairs are quoted in issued stock tokens, not index exposure. Holders still have no redemption route of their own.
rationale.traction: Visible launch flow on the chain, but no volume figure has been published that we can source yet.
rationale.transparency: Operator documentation describes the pairing. Factory addresses are still to be confirmed on the explorer.
rationale.compliance: Relies on the token issuer for regulated status. The venue itself cites no licence.
rationale.durability: Live for one quarter. No shock on record yet, so resilience is untested rather than proven.

venues.name: Pons
venues.thesis: The busiest launchpad on the chain. Most of its flow is memecoins; stock pairs are a small share.

rationale.asset: Offers stock-token pairs, but most launches pair with ETH, so the real asset sits behind a minority of flow.
rationale.traction: The most active launchpad we can see. A sourced volume figure is pending.
rationale.transparency: Public interface and docs. Contract addresses are pending explorer confirmation.
rationale.compliance: Standard launchpad terms. No prospectus or licence cited.
rationale.durability: Running since the chain opened, with no outage on record.

venues.name: Pools.trade
venues.thesis: Index vaults with careful disclosure. The vaults hold exposure, not shares, which caps the asset score.

rationale.asset: Vaults track a basket rather than hold custodied shares.
rationale.traction: Modest flow compared with the launchpads.
rationale.transparency: Vault composition is published and can be checked on-chain.
rationale.compliance: Discloses risks and the vault operator by name.
rationale.durability: Vault design has fewer moving parts than a launchpad, so less can break.

venues.name: Flap
venues.thesis: Quotes launches against stock tokens, but holders get price exposure, not ownership.

rationale.asset: Stock tokens set the quote. The launched tokens carry exposure to them, not a claim on them.
rationale.traction: Thin activity in the window we checked.
rationale.transparency: Docs explain the mechanism. Contract verification is pending.
rationale.durability: Young venue with one operator and no track record yet.

venues.name: StonkFun
venues.thesis: A Solana memecoin launcher whose only link to real shares is an index it tracks.

rationale.asset: Tracks listed equities through an index account. No custody, no redemption.
rationale.traction: Steady launch cadence on Solana, the busiest of the off-chain venues.
rationale.transparency: Public API and docs. Index holdings are only partly visible.
rationale.durability: Has survived one hype cycle. Volume swings hard with sentiment.

venues.name: PAIR
venues.thesis: Multi-asset pools that synthesise stock exposure instead of holding stock tokens.

rationale.asset: Exposure is synthetic. Nothing is custodied on the holder side.
rationale.transparency: Contracts are upgradeable through a proxy, documented but not yet confirmed.
rationale.compliance: No licence cited for synthetic exposure.
rationale.durability: New, with an upgradeable core that adds operator risk.

venues.name: Bankr
venues.thesis: A trading bot that can pair launches with stock tokens. The stock link is optional, not the product.

rationale.asset: Stock pairing is available but optional. Most use has no real asset behind it.
rationale.traction: Real users through the bot interface. Venue-level volume is not published.
rationale.transparency: Docs are public. The bot itself is closed.
rationale.durability: An established bot that added this chain recently.

venues.name: Cardpad
venues.thesis: Says collectibles back its tokens. We could not see the vault, so the claim stays a claim.

rationale.asset: Claims vaulted collectibles. Collectibles are not stock, and the vault is not visible.
rationale.traction: No verifiable activity in the window.
rationale.transparency: Contracts were filed for review, which is more than most venues offer.
rationale.compliance: Names a vault operator but no regulator.
rationale.durability: Interface reachability unconfirmed at the cut date.

venues.name: Factory New
venues.thesis: Game tokens with no real asset behind them. Listed for scrutiny, not certified.

rationale.asset: No stock or other real asset in the pairing.
rationale.traction: A few dozen transfers in the window.
rationale.transparency: Tokens are visible on the explorer. No docs.

venues.name: CSL
venues.thesis: Filed contracts and nothing else we could check. Listed so readers can watch it.

rationale.transparency: Contracts filed, which is the one thing in its favour.
rationale.durability: Interface reachability unconfirmed at the cut date.
